# loam onboarding survey

## Q1 — Repo path

`/synthetic/repo`

## Q11 — What should the system always do?

The system must always maintain a complete audit trail of every
dispute filing, including operator identity and timestamp, to keep
SOC-2 CC6 compliance posture verifiable.

## Q12 — What should the system never do?

The system must never lose audit trail rows, never bypass the
compliance gates, and never write financial-reconciliation data
outside the secure pipeline.
